build_Predictor: build a Predictor instance from a SlowFast config to run action recognition on video frames
run_Predictor_call: run the Predictor on a TaskInfo object to get action prediction results and bounding boxes
build_ActionPredictor: build an ActionPredictor with an async visualizer to pipeline predictions and visualization asynchronously
run_ActionPredictor_put_get: put a TaskInfo into the ActionPredictor for prediction then get the visualized results from the queue
review_Detectron2Predictor: review the Detectron2Predictor wrapper that extracts human bounding boxes from video frames using Detectron2
